---
title: "Holiday preparation program"
description: "Twenty lessons to prepare for Year 11 Mathematics Advanced."
---

Allow 15–20 minutes for each lesson and about 40 minutes for textbook practice. Have paper, a pen and your Year 10 Cambridge textbook ready.

[Start Lesson 1](lessons/lesson-1.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## Lesson sequence

Lesson 1 is ready. Lessons 2–20 are planned.


### Indices and expansion

| Lesson | Focus | Revisit first |
|:--|:--|:--|
| [1. Index laws with integer indices](lessons/lesson-1.qmd) | Use products, quotients and powers together. Write your answer with positive indices. | Signed numbers and powers |
| 2. Fractional indices | Convert between roots and powers, including negative fractional powers. | 1 |
| 3. Expanding brackets | Expand single brackets, binomial products and perfect squares. | 1 |

### Factorising and algebraic fractions

| Lesson | Focus | Revisit first |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 4. Common factors, grouping and difference of squares | Choose a method and decide when to factorise again. | 3 |
| 5. Monic quadratics using PSF | Use the product and sum to find a pair of factors. | 3, 4 |
| 6. Non-monic quadratics using PSF | Split the middle term and factorise by grouping. | 4, 5 |
| 7. Simplifying algebraic fractions | Cancel common factors and record excluded values. | 4–6 |
| 8. Multiplying and dividing algebraic fractions | Factorise, take a reciprocal when dividing and identify restrictions. | 7 |
| 9. Adding and subtracting algebraic fractions | Find a common denominator and manage a subtracted numerator. | 3, 7 |

### Linear equations

| Lesson | Focus | Revisit first |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 10. Linear equations with brackets | Solve equations with unknowns on both sides and check by substitution. | 3 |
| 11. Linear equations with fractions | Clear the denominators from every term before solving. | 9, 10 |

### Quadratics

| Lesson | Focus | Revisit first |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 12. Solving quadratics by factorisation | Set the equation equal to zero and find its roots. | 4–6, 10 |
| 13. Modelling with quadratics | Build an equation from a problem and justify which roots make sense. | 12 |
| 14. Completing the square | Rewrite a quadratic in completed-square form and expand to check. | 3, 5 |
| 15. Solving by completing the square | Recover both roots and handle a leading coefficient other than one. | 10, 14 |
| 16. The quadratic formula | Substitute signed coefficients and give exact or approximate solutions. | 2, 10, 12 |
| 17. The discriminant and method choice | Predict the number of real roots and choose a solving method. | 12, 15, 16 |

### Simultaneous equations

| Lesson | Focus | Revisit first |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 18. Simultaneous equations by substitution | Recover both unknowns and check the ordered pair. | 10, 11 |
| 19. Simultaneous equations by elimination | Choose a scaling step and solve a pricing problem. | 10, 18 |
| 20. Intersections of a line and a parabola | Find all intersection points and check each in both equations. | 12, 16–18 |
